Figure 1 : Overview of PhysVAM. (A) Comparison of visual and value-based future modeling. Visual prediction may suffer from geometric inconsistencies and lacks explicit task-progress supervision.
In contrast, PhysVAM predicts multi-horizon future values
to guide action generation. The h = 0 h=0 special case illustrates how favorable current-progress estimates may still precede unsuccessful interactions. (B) Multi-horizon value predictions decrease following
a missed grasp and increase during subsequent recovery
and successful lifting, reflecting changes in anticipated task progress. (C) PhysVAM achieves the highest success rates
among the compared methods in both simulation
and real-world tasks.
